project.name: appelli_db
project.description: Nx monorepo for a university exam-scheduling system. A NestJS + TypeORM/PostgreSQL API and a React 19 + Vite frontend (TailwindCSS + shadcn/Radix UI) where teachers coordinate exam dates within secretariat-configured planning windows, with JWT/Passport auth and role-based access (USER/ADMIN/TEACHER/SECRETARY).

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the documentation index to understand appelli_db: an Nx monorepo where university teachers coordinate exam scheduling within secretariat-configured planning windows. It maps the backend (NestJS + TypeORM) and frontend (React 19 + Vite) and the tech stack.

tour.title: Database Foundation
tour.description: The DatabaseModule wires TypeORM to PostgreSQL from PG_* environment variables with autoLoadEntities and synchronize enabled. Every backend entity ultimately persists through this connection.

tour.title: Users and Roles
tour.description: UserEntity is the single-table-inheritance base discriminated by the UserRole enum (USER, ADMIN, TEACHER, SECRETARY). TeacherEntity extends it via @ChildEntity. Roles drive authorization across the app.

tour.title: Authentication Flow
tour.description: The auth library validates email/password via the Passport local strategy, issues a JWT, then validates Bearer tokens on protected routes via the jwt strategy — the heart of the login flow.

tour.title: Security: Guards and Decorators
tour.description: Shared, reusable guards enforce auth and role-based access: JwtAuthGuard protects routes, RolesGuard reads @Roles metadata via the Reflector. These live in @server/security, not in each feature module.

tour.title: Domain Entities
tour.description: The exam-scheduling domain: degree programmes, exam sessions, and exams. Sessions define both the exam period and the insertion (planning) window; exams belong to a session, degree-year, teacher, and course.

tour.title: Exam Scheduling Business Rules
tour.description: exam.service.ts centralizes the core constraints: max one exam per day per (degree programme + year), inserts/edits only within the planning window, and weekend exclusion. This is where the project's business requirements become code.

tour.title: Session Configuration
tour.description: session.service.ts handles secretariat configuration: session start/end and insertion window dates, plus seeding. It defines the time boundaries the teacher workflow operates within.

tour.title: Seed Data
tour.description: courses-data.ts is the generated seed dataset (degrees, courses, teachers) parsed from the corsi/*.txt catalogs, used to populate the database on startup.

tour.title: API Application Wiring
tour.description: main.ts boots the NestJS app (CORS, the /api global prefix, Swagger at /api/docs); app.module.ts is the composition root assembling database, auth, users, security, and the domain feature modules.

tour.title: Frontend Bootstrap
tour.description: main.tsx mounts React; app.tsx sets up react-router-dom routing, protected routes, and the layout shell that gates teacher vs. secretariat views by role.

tour.title: Teacher Workflow UI
tour.description: The teacher's Esami page renders the session calendar grid, shows colleagues' booked exams, and lets a teacher insert/edit their own exam within the planning window — the primary user journey, talking to the API via teacher.api.ts.

tour.title: Secretariat Workflow UI
tour.description: The segreteria feature lets secretaries configure sessions, degree programmes, courses, and teachers through dedicated pages and modals, calling segreteria.api.ts — the setup side that the teacher workflow depends on.
